## Description

Replace the public-site layout (src/Host.Api/PublicSite/Shared/_Layout.cshtml) with the 6 Nov header: announcement bar, logo, Product and Solutions menus (with "By specialty"), Medvya Assist, Pricing, Security, region switch, Sign in, "Book a demo" and "Start free trial". On phones a menu button opens the same links. Footer as designed. Links to the App Store and Google Play show only when their store addresses are configured (PublicSite:AppLinks); until then they are hidden. Routes for the new pages are fixed here so other tickets can link them: /assist, /hospitals, /pricing, /trust, /demo.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given JavaScript is off, when a visitor opens the Product or Solutions menu or the phone menu, then it opens and closes and every link works (details/summary, no script).
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a keyboard user, when they tab through the header, then focus is visible, order follows reading order and every target is at least 44 px.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given Arabic, when the page renders, then the header and menus mirror right to left.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given no store addresses are configured, when the footer renders, then no App Store or Google Play links appear.
- [ ] **AC5.** No third-party scripts, fonts or trackers are added; axe is clean in en, hi and ar at 360, 768 and 1280 px.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
